description: Mint a short-lived private handle to one artifact of a signing request (native:<id>), with its SHA-256, size and media type: signed (the executed PDF), certificate (the audit certificate PDF), timestamp (the RFC 3161 token) or source (the published base PDF). signed, certificate and timestamp exist once the request is COMPLETED (ARTIFACT_NOT_SEALED before). Handles only, never file bytes: fetch the file before resource.expiresAt with an authenticated GET /api/public/v1/agreements/resources/{id} and check its SHA-256, or save it with the OpenTrain CLI (opentrain agreements requests download --out <file>). Every handle is recorded in the organization's audit log. Requires agreements:read. Requires the agreements family flag and the agreements_native rollout; denials carry details.reason (AGENT_SURFACE_DISABLED, AGREEMENTS_DISABLED, TENANT_ACCESS_DENIED).
name: opentrain_agreements_requests_download
